# Romeo Alpha Maritime

> Romeo Alpha Maritime Consultants and Logistics International Ltd is a vessel brokerage and marine services company headquartered in Port Harcourt, Nigeria. It does not own a fleet: it arranges vessel charter, marine security escort, offshore and oilfield support, maritime transportation, vessel repairs, and vessel sale, purchase and scrap through a network of trusted vessel owners, operators, yards and service providers. Most work is across Nigeria and the Gulf of Guinea, offshore and in creek and swamp locations; enquiries from the rest of West Africa and beyond are welcome.

## Company facts
- Legal name: Romeo Alpha Maritime Consultants and Logistics International Ltd
- Short name: Romeo Alpha Maritime
- Business type: vessel broker and marine services company (works through partners; does not own vessels)
- Headquarters: No. 58 Circular Road, Alcon Road, Woji, Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria
- Phone and WhatsApp: +234 805 576 9660 (WhatsApp), +234 806 618 4330
- Email: info@romeoalphamaritime.com
- Registration: Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) RC 9257242; SCUML (EFCC) registered; NIMASA-licensed shipping company, registration SC261080
- Enquiries: received 24/7 by email, WhatsApp and social media, checked every day including weekends

## Services
- [Vessel Chartering](https://romeoalphamaritime.com/service/charter): sourcing crew boats, FSIVs, tugs, barges, AHTS, PSVs, DP2 vessels and houseboats from partner owners and operators, with charter terms, crew and mobilisation coordinated.
- [Marine Security Escort](https://romeoalphamaritime.com/service/security): security escort vessels for supply runs, crew changes and cargo movements, with route and risk assessment before each movement.
- [Offshore & Oilfield Support](https://romeoalphamaritime.com/service/offshore): supply runs, anchor handling, towing, crew transfer, houseboat accommodation and barges for drilling, production, construction and maintenance campaigns.
- [Maritime Transportation](https://romeoalphamaritime.com/service/maritime): movement of dry and liquid cargo and project equipment along the Nigerian coast and inland waterways, towage, and vessel sale, purchase and scrap.
- [Marketplace](https://romeoalphamaritime.com/marketplace): vessels and marine equipment for sale or hire, scrap vessel sales, and repairs arranged through partner yards.

## Frequently asked questions
- What services does Romeo Alpha offer? Vessel charter, marine security escort, offshore and oilfield support, maritime transportation, vessel repairs, and vessel sale, purchase and scrap, all delivered through trusted partners.
- Does Romeo Alpha own the vessels? No. It is a broker that sources vessels from trusted owners and operators, some already on location and others contacted for each requirement.
- Where does Romeo Alpha work? Mostly Nigeria and the Gulf of Guinea, offshore and in creek and swamp locations, with enquiries from the rest of West Africa and beyond welcome.
- How do I request a quote? Use the "Get Quotes" button or contact form, email info@romeoalphamaritime.com, or call or WhatsApp +234 805 576 9660 with the vessel or service, location, start date and duration.
- Can I contact Romeo Alpha 24/7? Yes. Enquiries are received 24/7 by email, WhatsApp and social media and checked every day, including weekends.
- What registrations does Romeo Alpha hold? CAC incorporation (RC 9257242), SCUML registration under the EFCC, and a NIMASA shipping company licence. See https://romeoalphamaritime.com/certifications.
- How can I partner with Romeo Alpha? Vessel owners, operators, shipyards and marine service providers can contact the team via https://romeoalphamaritime.com/contact; vessel owners can list vessels for charter or sale.
